comment.body: Thanks for the detailed Alt-key reproduction. Could you attach a PowerToys bug-report ZIP and confirm your exact Windows build (`winver`), whether the problem affects Left Alt, Right Alt, or both, and whether it reproduces in Notepad? Please also include a screenshot of one affected remap and say whether PowerToys or the target app is running elevated. If practical, confirm whether uninstalling the suspected Windows update changes the behavior.
